sentences.en: My boss dictated a letter for his secretary to type.
sentences.zh: 我的老板口述了一封信让他的秘书打字。

sentences.en: Write down what the teacher dictates in the French class.
sentences.zh: 把老师在法语课上讲的内容记下来。

sentences.en: You can't just walk in here and start dictating policy.
sentences.zh: 你不能随便进来就指挥政策。
